title: Chapter 92 The First Village Destroyed
content:
Chapter 92 The First Village Destroyed

Wang Shuo had already thought about it before.

Just recruiting tools from the ancient battlefield.

It is far from enough to meet the needs of his territory for soldiers.

He still has to find a way from these people.

However, those who are reused must have been "brainwashed" by the "Thought Stamp" scroll.

Among this batch of militiamen, as long as there are those who are willing to accept the baptism of the scroll, they will be incorporated into his core troops.

On the battlefield, wild beasts are pouring in.

In just a few minutes, the wolf pack was killed and injured.

At this time, the system prompt sounded.

[Each village automatically enters the village defense battle, and the beast killing ranking list is opened. ]

[The village that wins the defense battle and ranks in the top ten in the number of beasts killed will receive generous rewards. ]

And at this time, everyone has also opened the killing ranking list.

In Wana Village, the first place at this time is naturally Ayub.

For ordinary beasts, he could cause serious injuries with one cut, either missing arms and legs or having a deep wound on the neck, thus losing combat effectiveness.

Although the health value of the beast is very high, if it is fatally injured, it will be directly judged as a fatal blow, and the damage will be doubled.

The wolves have not been completely killed yet, and bison rushed to the vicinity of the city wall.

These bisons with huge impact force directly hit the city wall with their hard horns.

Ants shake trees!

There was only a crisp sound, and the horns were broken.

After seeing this, Wang Shuo opened his eyes wide and showed an incredible expression.

"They are simply not willing to die!"

These beasts are too cruel!

When they are cruel, they don't even want their own lives!

At the same time, Wang Shuo also felt that these beasts were a bit pathetic!

They can't even control their own lives.

Thinking of himself, it seems that there is not much difference between him and these beasts.

However, this idea did not make Wang Shuo sink or decadent.

Instead, it inspired him to challenge his fate.

"Lord Zach, one day, I will stand in front of you!" Wang Shuo shouted angrily in his heart.

The anger in his heart made Wang Shuo output more frantically, killing the beast in front of him.

...

[Meng Meng Village, the administrative center was breached by beasts and removed from the system. ]

A system prompt sounded without any warning, which made Wang Shuo's heart tighten and his hands paused.

Has a village been breached so soon?

As soon as you see the name, you know that it is a village formed by a few strong-willed little girls.

In front of this ferocious beast, it seems so vulnerable.

It didn't even last ten minutes.

This system prompt cast a shadow in the hearts of many lords at the same time.

Everyone is a little worried whether they will become the next village to be destroyed.

In the [chat channel], there are still many people who stay in the system town.

"I know this Mengmeng Village. Their village chief is called Li Xiaomeng. We fought monsters together yesterday!"

"Oh? (⊙o⊙), I thought you played poker together!"

"In this dangerous survival world, isn't it better to be an ordinary salted fish? You have to build a village in the wild. Now you have lost your life. I am doing odd jobs in the county town. I am looking for a girlfriend who wants to live a stable life."

Men's Gang Zeng Gang: "Things like hegemony should be done by men. I am the seventh hall master of the Men's Gang. The Men's Gang recruits real men above level 10!"

Wild Rose: "Bah! Men are great, and women can also hold up half the sky. Flame Rose recruits female players. Sisters, let's unite and don't have to look at the faces of men. The gathering place is Nanshanji."

……
